resolvedFindings.evidence: completeRun(runDir, CompleteRunInput) is the descriptor-driven production terminal-write API. Caller supplies only typed descriptors (consumedRunIds, producedArtifactTags, reviewedRunId, reviewVerdict, reviewFindings); Core derives all ResultRefs via deriveActionResult → buildRunResultRef / buildArtifactResultRef / deriveReviewVerdictRef / deriveVerificationSummaryArtifactRef. Initial explore/propose ignore caller tags and unconditionally build the complete Core-expected produced set (validateInitialArtifactCompleteness no longer gates on producedResultRefs presence). review-apply unconditionally derives verificationSummaryRef from current verification.md; missing/unreadable/ambiguous target → RESULT_REF_TARGET_MISSING (Run stays pending). writeRunResult remains exported only as the low-level publish primitive (fs.link / assertMutable / race protocol) with no production callers; both paths route through publishTerminalResult which runs the same completion preflight. Negative fixtures cover omitted producedResultRefs (initial explore/propose) and omitted review-apply verificationSummaryRef.

src/facts/generation-resolver.ts centralizes exact lineage classification. isLegitimateArtifactSuccessor requires a completed review-<stage> R with R.reviewedRunId == g0.runId, R.verdict == changes-requested, AND g1.sourceReviewRun == R.runId, g1.sourceReviewVerdict == changes-requested — Run ID ordering is NOT consulted (used only for deterministic presentation). classifyArtifactGenerations accepts allReviseRuns including PENDING revise Runs, so a legitimate pending revise opens a bounded revision-window and canonical bytes may change without false mutable conflict. classifyVerificationGenerations uses the same exact review-apply → revise-apply lineage (isLegitimateVerificationSuccessor). RunFact (src/facts/formal-fact-snapshot.ts) carries sourceReviewRun / sourceReviewVerdict / reviewedRunId. formal-fact-reader.ts integrates the shared resolver via buildReviewLineageFacts. Integration fixtures cover legitimate revise → superseded (no false conflict), no-lineage overwrite → fail-closed, and verification generation-aware lifecycle.

validateReviewEntry(input) runs inside createRun for review-explore/review-propose BEFORE the review Run is staged/published. It (1) reads the reviewed Run's lineage fact + producedResultRefs; (2) reads sibling lineage facts; (3) classifies the reviewed Run's generation via the shared classifyReviewedArtifactGeneration — MUST be current; (4) validates producedResultRefs against current canonical bytes via the shared validateEffectiveArtifactRefs; (5) for review-propose exact-compares effective specs identities with current canonical specs/** via the shared validateSpecsExactSet. On any mismatch/missing/namespace drift it throws RESULT_REF_MISMATCH / RESULT_REF_TARGET_MISSING before publish. The same shared validators (result-ref-adapter.ts) are reused by completion preflight and Reader, satisfying one-fact-one-authority. Negative fixtures cover post-terminal/pre-review artifact drift and specs namespace drift rejecting before review Run publish.

validateResultRefProjection (src/persistence/serialization.ts) requires ResultRef.kind for every schemaVersion 2 projection: missing → SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED; empty ('') → reject; unknown → reject; closed schema rejects unknown fields. Field-specific kind binding (validateOptionalResultRef / validateOptionalResultRefArray) uses exact equality (ref.kind !== expectedKind) — no legacy `if kind !== undefined` tolerance. Binding: producedResultRefs → produced-artifact; consumedInputRefs → run-result; verificationSummaryRef → verification-summary; reviewVerdictRef → run-result. schemaVersion 1 legacy recognition preserved separately. Negative fixtures cover missing-kind, empty-kind, unknown-kind, and field-kind mismatch.
